rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter closely: reuses cookieFilterAction/filterAction, same Validate/CaddyModule/Unmarshal shape, registered beside cookie, interface guards added in all three blocks.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles unparseable lines, exact name match, quoted-value preservation, delete-from-array, non-array passthrough; hash of empty value noted. Whitespace-only value would duplicate padding (minor, unlikely).
rationale.scope: Only adds the new filter, registration and guards; no unrelated changes or refactors.
rationale.readability: Clear split into Filter/filterLine/replaceSetCookieValue; whitespace-preservation arithmetic is a bit verbose but commented.
rationale.robustness: No panics: all slicing is bounded, parse failure passes through, redundant defensive checks on '=' and name. Leading/trailing whitespace math is slightly fragile but safe.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's rather than a shared helper; otherwise small, self-contained and easy to extend.
